description: DealCloud is a CRM and deal management platform tailored for financial services, private equity, and investment banking.
auth_notes: Supports API keys and authorization tokens (Bearer tokens) for authenticating API requests.
credential_notes: DealCloud is an enterprise platform requiring an enterprise subscription or direct engagement with sales/partners to provision workspace access and API credentials.
api_notes: Comprehensive REST API covering core schema, entry types, data management, user management, files, history, backups, and relationship intelligence.
mcp_notes: DealCloud provides official documentation and support for Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and AI client integrations.
rationale: Although DealCloud has a broad, well-documented REST API and official MCP support, obtaining credentials requires an enterprise subscription and sales/partner engagement.

evidence.note: Official DealCloud Developer Documentation outlining API Reference, SDKs, and MCP guides.
